verdict.rationale: Docs show explicit hierarchy entities (features, components, initiatives, objectives/key results) and APIs/UI features to associate feedback and features into this hierarchy (e.g., adding features to initiatives, connecting feedback to features/components). This directly matches the PM story of organizing requests into a feature/component/initiative hierarchy. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the hierarchy UI in practice, and no detailed walkthrough of the native (non-API) hierarchy management UI.
